messages:
Mira: Quick sync 1: want to run a tiny active-active failover probe for EU tenants tonight. Low blast: 1% traffic, snapshot writes only (no commit). Thoughts?

Leo: +1. Prefer snapshot/dry-run so we don't mutate state. Also add X-Consent-Token enforcement for EU.

Tanya: Agreed. Add these check points: disable prefix KV cache for probe tenants, emit route.policy header, and include an idempotency key pattern.

Mira: Plan: proxy rule `orbit-probe-v1` -> split 99/1, shadow path to resident sandbox returns 202/dry-run. Run 2k synthetic writes then 1% prod for 2h.

Leo: Telemetry: probe_mismatch_rate, probe_latency_p95_delta, kv.cache_hits_by_policy, probe_error_rate. Auto-revert if mismatch_rate > 0.05% for 10m.

Tanya: Also add comparator service with fuzzy-tolerance (normalize tokens, ignore non-deterministic metadata). Threshold comparator_score > 0.03 flags.

ops-bot: Canary queued: proxy/orbit-probe-v1 -> canary-128. Dashboard: https://obs.local/canary/128

privacy-bot: Shadow logs must be masked (pii-hash) and retention 7d. X-Consent-Token mandatory; non-compliant requests are excluded and counted.

Leo: Rollback owners: Tanya primary, Mira secondary. If probe_latency_p95 delta > 250ms AND probe_error_rate > 0.2% trip immediately.

Mira: I'll open the PR with proxy rule + dashboard. If this succeeds, follow-up RFC to add a lightweight per-tenant "probe" toggle in control plane.

Tanya: One more: ensure resident sandbox cannot change routing metadata or leases. It must be strictly read/dry-run.

Mira: Good catch. Will add sandbox guard and a test that attempts commit and verifies it's rejected. Posting PR in 10m. :hourglass:
